newsitem.title: USA: CFC sees Q2 EPS below analysts' estimates.
newsitem.headline: CFC sees Q2 EPS below analysts' estimates.

text.p: CFC International Inc said late on Monday that it expects its second quarter earnings to come in below analysts' projections.
The company said in a statement that the quarter was expected to be hurt by capacity concerns in its printed products line.
CFC designs, manufactures and markets functional coatings for industrial and consumer products.
Although it said it has had "strong orders", the company has been unable fill them all because a new press is still not fully on-line.

In addition, CFC has compiled unanticipated overtime costs to get the new press on-line more quickly and to provide additional revenue from other areas of the business, it said. CFC said the additional overtime is likely to "have a negative impact on earnings."

The company did not say what analysts' projections it was basing its latest forecast. However, according to First Call, the analysts' mean estimate is $0.25 per share for the second quarter. In the prior year's second quarter, CFC posted net income of $1.1 million, or $0.24 per share, on sales of $9.88 million.
The company said it expects the new press will be fully operational during the 1997 third quarter.
